name: OCSP Stapling
description: Enable OCSP stapling for SSL/TLS certificates. Improves certificate validation performance and privacy by reducing OCSP responder load.

OCSP_STAPLE_MODE.help: OCSP stapling mode: open (optional, no validation), staple_only (must have staple), normal (validated if available)
OCSP_STAPLE_MODE.label: OCSP staple mode

OCSP_ASYNC_VALIDATION.help: Enable asynchronous OCSP validation in background scheduler job (reduces TLS critical path latency)
OCSP_ASYNC_VALIDATION.label: Enable async OCSP validation

OCSP_ASYNC_SCHEDULE.help: How often the async validation job runs: minute (1 min), 5minute, hour
OCSP_ASYNC_SCHEDULE.label: Async validation schedule

OCSP_CACHE_DIR.help: Directory for OCSP response cache storage
OCSP_CACHE_DIR.label: OCSP cache directory
